description: VM Creation Modal - Multi-Step Bot Configuration for OpenClaw VMs

userStories.title: Create API endpoint for VM creation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a backend endpoint to handle VM creation requests that publishes to Redis.
acceptanceCriteria: Create POST /api/vms endpoint in src/routes/api/vms/+server.ts
Add Zod validation for request body (name, token, passcode, minionId)
Auto-fill technical fields: model='moonshot/kimi-k2.5', ram=4, cpus=2, disk=20
Auto-fill profiles=[minionId], channels.telegram.dmPolicy='passcode', env.BOT_PASSCODE=passcode
Publish formatted message to Redis clawd:commands channel
Return appropriate success/error response
Typecheck passes
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented with Zod validation, Redis publishing to clawd:commands channel, demo mode fallback

userStories.title: Create VM Creation Modal shell component
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable modal component that hosts the multi-step flow with proper animations.
acceptanceCriteria: Create VMCreationModal.svelte in src/lib/components/
Full-screen overlay with backdrop blur effect
Click outside or X button closes modal with confirmation if form is dirty
Escape key closes modal
Scale + fade animations for open/close transitions
Export props: isOpen, selectedMinion, onClose, onSuccess
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill - screenshot desktop (1280x720) and mobile (375x812)
userStories.notes: Implemented with backdrop blur, scale/fade animations, confirmation dialog for dirty form, SSR-safe window access

userStories.title: Build Step 1 - Name Your Bot
userStories.description: As a user, I want to give my bot a memorable name with real-time validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Display selected Minion avatar and name at top of step
Single text input for bot name with 3-30 character limit
Validate alphanumeric + hyphen only format
Real-time validation showing error for invalid format or existing name
Next button disabled until valid name entered
Step indicator showing 'Step 1 of 4'
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill - screenshots: empty input, invalid name error, valid name state
userStories.notes: Implemented Step 1 with real-time validation, character counter, step indicator, visual feedback states

userStories.title: Build Step 2 - Telegram Configuration
userStories.description: As a user, I want to connect my Telegram bot with a masked token input and helpful guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: Password-masked input for Telegram bot token
Show/hide toggle button for token visibility
Help text with link to @BotFather instructions
Validate token format matches pattern: digits:alphanumeric
Back button returns to Step 1, Next proceeds to Step 3
Next button disabled until valid token format entered
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill - screenshots: masked state, revealed state, error state

userStories.title: Build Step 3 - Security Passcode
userStories.description: As a user, I want to set a passcode with an option to auto-generate a secure one.
acceptanceCriteria: Input for passcode with 4-20 character limit
Show/hide toggle for passcode visibility
Dice icon button to generate random 8-character passcode
Explanatory text: 'Users must message this passcode to the bot before accessing it'
Back button returns to Step 2, Next proceeds to Step 4
Next button disabled until valid passcode length entered
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill - screenshots: empty input, generated passcode, revealed state

userStories.title: Build Step 4 - Review and Launch
userStories.description: As a user, I want to review my configuration and see credit costs before launching my bot.
acceptanceCriteria: Summary card displaying: Minion avatar+name, bot name, Telegram status, masked passcode with reveal toggle
Credit cost breakdown: hourly rate (95 credits/hour), current balance, estimated runtime
Yellow warning banner when balance < 2 hours of runtime
Back button returns to Step 3
Launch Bot primary button with loading state during API call
Error message display if API call fails
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill - screenshots: sufficient credits, low balance warning, loading state

userStories.title: Integrate modal with CharacterSelector
userStories.description: As a user, clicking HIRE on any Minion should open the creation modal with proper data flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace hireMinion event dispatch in CharacterSelector with modal open
Pass selected Minion data (id, name, color) to modal
Modal uses Minion color as accent throughout
On successful launch: close modal and show success toast notification
On API error: display error in modal, stay on review step
Reset form state when modal reopens
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill - record E2E video: HIRE click through all steps to launch

userStories.title: Implement responsive mobile experience
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want the modal to be fully functional on my phone with touch-friendly interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Full-screen modal on mobile (< 768px viewport)
All tap targets minimum 44x44px
Bottom-fixed action buttons on mobile viewport
Sticky header with back/close on mobile
Scrollable content area when content exceeds viewport
Proper viewport meta tag for mobile scaling
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill - screenshots all 4 steps at 375x812 and 768x1024 viewports

Test: Modal opens from HIRE button click
